lead.headline: Rice is out, you trail by 41.5 — Jacobs is expected to play
lead.deck: The lineup is the projection lineup. One check before 10:30: if Jacobs is ruled out, Gordon goes back in before Miami lock him at 11:00.
lead.body: Start with the bad news: Rashee Rice is out for a second straight week and Furia Regia banked 41.5 on Thursday, so ESPN gives you 39%. The lineup as set is the projection lineup. Josh Jacobs is the one starter with a question mark: ESPN still tags him day-to-day, but that is the exempt-list label — Green Bay activated him Saturday and Schefter reports he is expected to play. Green Bay's inactives arrive at 12:55, after Gordon locks at 11:00, so the real check is 10:30. Everyone else is clean on the final reports: Golden not listed, Pickens full Friday, Likely with every tight-end snap. After Stroud's game, the Loveland claim stands before waivers clear Wednesday at 01:00.

doFirst.headline: One check, one claim
doFirst.deck: Jacobs by 10:30 CDMX today; Loveland for Stroud before Wed 01:00 CDMX.
doFirst.note: Hold the Jets D/ST (8.0 against the Titans' 7.7) and Gay (9.6 against Butker's 10.2) — both coin flips. Loveland costs your waiver priority (5th, never resets).
doFirst.empty: Nothing else to fire before kickoff.
